rows.details: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Ansari Nagar, New Delhi
I-2030, "Development and Validation of Digital Intervention for Geriatric Patients with Cognitive Impairment and Care Givers (vs Care as Usual): Two-Arm Parallel Randomized Controlled Trial"
Project duration 3 years; tenure six months initially, with extension up to 3 years depending on performance
As per ICMR Guidelines – Rs. 67,000 + HRA @ 30% [= Rs 87,100/Month]
Department of Psychiatry, AIIMS, New Delhi

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The post sits in the Department of Psychiatry, AIIMS, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi. The project is funded by ICMR and deals with geriatric mental health, specifically a digital intervention for elderly patients with cognitive impairment and their care givers, tested in a two-arm parallel randomized controlled trial. The notice is issued over the name of Dr. Preethy K, Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Graduate Degree of Four Years in Engineering / Information Technology / Computer Science with three years' post-qualification experience. OR Post Graduate Degree in Computer Science / Information Technology or other relevant discipline, including the integrated PG degrees, with three years post qualification experience or PhD. Specialisation or demonstrated expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Software Engineering, Mobile Application Development, Web Application Development and Digital Health Technologies. Experience of working in Mental Health. Experience of working with patients with cognitive impairment. Experience in clinical research and project management. The age limit printed in the notice is 40 Years. The notice does not print an age relaxation or a date for counting age. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The project duration is 3 years. The tenure will be for six months initially, with extension up to 3 years depending on performance. If ineligibility is detected at any stage of the recruitment, the appointment will be cancelled.

rows.monthly_emoluments: As per ICMR Guidelines – Rs. 67,000 + HRA @ 30% [= Rs 87,100/Month]

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical)
content_sections.text: Applications are to be submitted online through the Google Form at https://forms.gle/17wPApfDhnutv1m26 . The CV and documents must be submitted online by 30 November 2026, 23:59 IST. No hand-delivered or hard copy application will be accepted. Documents named in the notice: CV and documents, submitted online with the application. Original documents, to be brought at the time of interview by eligible candidates.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only short-listed candidates will be called for the interview. Eligible candidates are requested to bring their original documents at the time of interview. No TA/DA will be provided for appearing in the interview. The notice does not mention the interview date or venue.

content_sections.text: If ineligibility is detected at any stage of the recruitment, the appointment will be cancelled. All applications are to be submitted online; hand-delivered or hard copies will not be accepted.
